description: This file declares functions for JavaScript binding management for the AAMP module in WPEWebKit, including loading and unloading JS bindings and setting HTTP headers.

methods.name: LoadJSBindings
methods.description: Function to load JavaScript bindings into a given WebKit bundle frame.

methods.name: UnloadJSBindings
methods.description: Function to unload JavaScript bindings from a given WebKit bundle frame.

methods.name: SetHttpHeaders
methods.description: Function to set HTTP headers using a JSON string.
